signals.headline: Core and payments modernization decide whether digital value shows up.
signals.body: FedNow/RTP, ACH, wire, sanctions, fraud, and API gateway dependencies mean payments value should be sequenced as a cross-domain modernization path, not a channel feature.

signals.headline: AI scale is blocked by model-risk evidence, not by lack of use cases.

move.title: Approve monitored scale of SAR narrative drafting copilot

signals.headline: Customer and transaction data products are the CDAO control point.

signals.headline: Usage-only AI reporting is not enough for the CFO.

ask.contract: Every answer is grounded in enterprise evidence, industry context, and clear caveats when facts are missing.

suggestedQuestions: Which Northstar moves should we accelerate, restructure, or kill?
What blocks TSA exit and ERP simplification?
Where is clinical coding AI exposed to QMS or model-risk controls?
Which vendor renewals and app run costs deserve CFO/CIO attention first?

signals.headline: TSA exit and ERP simplification are the first constraint on the independent operating model.
signals.body: Northstar is a newly independent medtech enterprise with board pressure to exit parent TSAs without disrupting regulated operations. The ERP estate spans SAP S/4HANA, Oracle EBS, JD Edwards, Infor LN, Dynamics AX, AS/400, and mainframe workloads, so independence is an operating-risk question before it is an IT cleanup question.

move.title: Gate TSA exit by regulated-process and ERP dependency evidence

signals.headline: $250M margin expansion depends on separating verified moves from projected value.
signals.body: The board has a $250M margin-expansion priority, while SAP S/4 Wave 0 and JDE Dental Sunset carry large projected values but different recommendation states. Ava should force the CFO/CIO discussion onto evidence-backed realization, not initiative optimism.

move.title: Re-baseline ERP simplification against verified margin evidence

signals.headline: Clinical coding AI should accelerate only with regulated evidence guardrails.
signals.body: Clinical coding AI is a board-level modernization priority, but the footprint marks it as a regulated high-risk workflow. QMS events, CAPA history, and model-risk evidence have to travel with the business case before scale.

move.title: Accelerate clinical coding AI with QMS and model-risk controls

signals.headline: Near-term vendor renewals create leverage and data-rights risk.
signals.body: SAP, Infosys, Azure, ServiceNow, and PTC renewals are material enough to shape the margin plan. The renewal conversation should join commercial exposure, AI/data-rights terms, exit provisions, and operational dependency instead of treating renewals as procurement events.

move.title: Bundle renewal decisions with data-rights and exit-term review

signals.headline: QMS evidence automation is a value move only if source traceability is preserved.
signals.body: QMS events include complaint trends, FDA 483 observations, EU MDR remediation, design-history gaps, and CAPA activity. The QMS evidence move can scale if it improves traceability and audit readiness, not if it merely summarizes quality documents.

move.title: Accelerate QMS evidence automation with audit-location receipts

signals.headline: Application rationalization is operational risk work, not cosmetic portfolio trimming.
signals.body: Northstar has 240 application records, critical regulated systems, legacy ERP/platform dependencies, and incident patterns tied to plant edge networks, QMS validation, identity sync, and ERP batch failure. Rationalization should start where run cost, regulated scope, and incident history intersect.

move.title: Sequence app rationalization by regulated criticality and incident evidence
